added.detail: Function `public.ensure_marketplace_account()` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/ensure_marketplace_account`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

assessment: The one new advisory flags the intentional authenticated SECURITY DEFINER self-recovery RPC. It takes no identity input, validates the live Auth session, calls revoked private setup helpers, and adds only ordinary capabilities. No new anonymous definer exposure.
